title: iCloud Drive (hourly) sync stale (no successful run in 4h)

annotations.description: Mac Studio's `~/bin/icloud-drive-sync.sh` (Desktop + Documents + iCloud Drive misc → Nextcloud) heartbeats `started`/`idle`/`uploaded`/`failed`/`locked` events to Loki on every run. Fires hourly via launchd. Zero `idle`/`uploaded` events for 4h means launchd is unloaded, the script is broken, the Mac Studio is offline, Nextcloud auth has expired, or Loki ingest is failing. Check `launchctl list | grep icloud-drive`, `~/icloud-drive-sync.log`, `~/Library/Logs/rclone-documents-sync-launchd.log`. Dashboard: /d/immich-sync/icloud-synchronisation
annotations.summary: iCloud Drive hourly sync stale: zero successful runs in 4 hours
